ruling.recommended_action: Refund SGD 4.22 (3.0 km × $1.41/km metered distance) by Ryde voucher within 30 days; note driver's RD-1 shortest-route breach; no account flag (route upheld count = 0).

segment_findings.reason: Rider named the stop (Paya Lebar Square, F9) and driver agreed before the deviation (F10 12:21 earlier than segment start 12:24), so the route change to reach the requested stop is covered by RD-3(a); the 4 min stationary period F2 coincides with the requested 3–4 min parcel stop.

Residual +3.5 km actual-vs-optimal excess [F1] is not explained by traffic: no incidents [F14] and only band-4 (30–39 km/h) readings [F12][F13], which do not meet RD-4(a)/(b); the unexempt portion therefore remains billable to the driver under RD-2.

rejected_claims.reason: RydeTAXI metered waiting time is chargeable per RD-3(c) (F6 $1.04, 4.0 min at $0.26/min) for a rider-requested stop.
Fare is metered and only the unexempt detour mileage is refundable under RD-2; the requested stop and its waiting time are legitimate.
